text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr has surpassed the Mile
Emperor
and proven that a free wind
cannot be contained.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her crucial first three years come to a
close in the
best possible way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while still basking in the glory
of our
accomplishments...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's a pleasant breeze. What do
you think
of it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Yamanin Zephyr and I have come
out for
a stroll in a forest near her
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, what an opportune
airstream we
have here. Take a look over
there—it's a
Big-Beak.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a wonderful breeze.
Yeah, the breeze feels wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
They set off on a journey at the start of
spring, so
we're lucky to have seen one.
What a propitious
flurry.
choice_data_list: You're right. What a cute oriental...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Oriental greenfinch is a wild bird
known for having a large beak. Although
they're not particularly rare, people
tend not to notice them unless they're
paying attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look around to see that Yamanin
Zephyr has
vanished without my
noticing.
choice_data_list: That's the beauty of going for a s...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: Um, which way would Zephyr go—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... Where did you get off to?
Did you
find yourself a pappus on the
wind for a moment?
choice_data_list: I had a feeling you'd be over here.
I had a feeling you'd be over here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she was the one that
disappeared, I
decide not to push back
on her query.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You must have felt a roseate current.
Was there
rustling?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Just wandering around a bit.
Yeah. Just wandered around a bit.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm glad. Say, shall we let the
benison
breeze blow?
choice_data_list: Yeah. It was a lovely breeze.
Yeah. That was a nice breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh? Erm, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Wanna take it easy? Then let's hea...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Something feels a bit off.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well...
I think I'm a little out of step with
other
people.
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Often, the conversations I'm in come to
a
standstill, and I'm asked to repeat
myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And sometimes I'll be walking alongside
someone,
only to suddenly end up on
my own...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I always assumed these experiences were
normal,
and never gave them a second
thought...
choice_data_list: (Well, I figured as much...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But when I'm with you, even when that
kind of
thing happens... it doesn't really
bother me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...It's strange.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, we have spent three years in each
other's company, after all. It's no wonder
I've gotten used to her, or at least
gotten an idea of what to expect from
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To put it in her words...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...A weather vane?
choice_data_list: Does that mean you've become like ...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, perhaps it's...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Interesting... You've become a true wind
as
well—for me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, I think a part of me always
felt that
"becoming the wind" was a
ridiculous dream.
choice_data_list: Wait...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But even so, once I started getting good
results in
my races, people started
telling me that I ran like
the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You may be right. But still... I believe
there's been
a wind at my back all along,
pushing me forwards.
choice_data_list: It's the result of all your hard work.
It's the fruits of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You were that fair wind at my back,
Trainer. And
thanks to you, I've soared
to heights I never
thought I'd reach.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I was just a leaf drifting about
on the
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if I am pushing her forward, she was
the one
who ultimately achieved those
results.
choice_data_list: That's not true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why, dare I say it...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: The two of us became the wind.
The two of us became the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Interesting.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The winds are free spirits, and that's
exactly why
they're able to overlap and
blow as one.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A warm updraft, a sweet breeze, a
refreshing whoosh... It feels as though
countless currents
suddenly just picked
up into one comforting wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Will you stay a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's bathe in the wind,
right here... Just
for a
little longer.
